name: twrses-astro
description: 天文教育 3D 模型的原始碼與打包設定。產物寫到 assets/js/，npm run build 重新打包。

scripts.build: esbuild src/moon-phases.js src/eclipses.js src/seasons.js src/tides.js src/constellations.js src/north-star.js src/planets-lab.js src/sundial.js src/solar.js src/star-distance.js src/meteors-lab.js src/star-colors.js src/moon-face.js src/milky-way.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --legal-comments=eof --outdir=../../assets/js
scripts.test: node test/ephem.test.mjs && node test/seasons.test.mjs && node test/stars.test.mjs && node test/planets.test.mjs && node test/sundial.test.mjs && node test/distance.test.mjs && node test/meteors.test.mjs && node test/starcolor.test.mjs && node test/libration.test.mjs && node test/galaxy.test.mjs
